snippet.title: Hull Rupture - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hull Rupture and play the updated demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358660/Hull_Rupture/ 

Hull Rupture launches November 4, 2026!

Hull Rupture is a base-management, tower-defense roguelite set in Despot’s universe, known from Despot’s Game, Slime 3K, and Despotism 3k. This time, Despot is making his revenge the whole galaxy's problem.

🚀 Build and expand your warship with interconnected hull blocks
⚙️ Construct modules and manage resource production
👾 Build and optimize modules to defend the Despot’s ship against invading aliens
🌌 Choose your route through the galaxy and deal with the dangers you find
👤 Put humans to work as crew, defenders, and emergency fuel
🎮 Combine 3 ships and 6 game modes to change each run

The updated demo introduces Hull Construction, a reworked Post-Battle Shop, movable turrets, converter automation, a resource income display, new artifacts and modifiers, and general balance changes.
